entries.08ff772293efdc93: These are devices such as solenoid valves that switch the direction of compressed air flow. In January 1971 the company began manufacturing and selling direct-acting solenoid valves. Together with drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, these make up the product group that the company calls 'pneumatic equipment'. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed a manifold-type compact 5-port solenoid valve supporting up to 64 stations and an angle seat valve with an added ATEX-compliant series.
entries.17795620dd2d311e: This is the sole business segment of the SMC Group, which manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, component devices essential to factory automation (FA). Its products consist of pneumatic equipment, including directional control equipment, drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, as well as temperature control equipment and sensors, among others. These are component parts built into production and conveying lines of automated factories, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, industrial robots and other equipment. The company positions itself as a 'general manufacturer of pneumatic equipment' that makes and sells all equipment used on compressed air piping, and cites as its competitive advantage a range of 880,000 items and a short-lead-time, immediate-delivery system backed by ample inventory. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥842,541 million (up 6.4% year on year), production was ¥843,896 million (up 12.8%), orders received were ¥872,261 million (up 13.2%), order backlog was ¥118,156 million (up 33.6%), and the number of employees was 24,773 (temporary employees of 5,616 are not included).

entries.41af86c9e29bce7e: As automatic control equipment other than pneumatic equipment, the company handles temperature control equipment that keeps temperature constant and sensors and the like that detect the status of equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed refrigeration-type thermochillers compatible with non-fluorocarbon (CO2 refrigerant), refrigeration-type thermochillers compatible with low-GWP refrigerants and a dual type for lasers, wireless auto switches, bar-type ionizers with dust-proof and drip-proof specifications, clamp-on flow sensors for liquids, digital flow switches of the large-flow type, and others.
entries.5704d41cd8d620f6: These are devices for cleaning compressed air, regulating its pressure and supplying it to equipment. This product group, which began with the manufacture and sale of air triple sets in September 1961, is the first product group that SMC CORPORATION handled among its automatic control equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed stainless-steel compressed air cleaning filters, in-line air filters, booster valves, remote adjustment valves (electric speed controllers), membrane nitrogen generators and others. Products in this area also underpin proposals such as '4BAR factory', which lowers air pressure across an entire factory, 'AMS (air management system)', which constantly monitors air usage and automatically lowers pressure according to equipment operation, and 'energy-saving booster valves', which boost pressure locally only where needed.

entries.cdcdc53a3ff46185: These are devices that convert the force of compressed air into linear motion and the like, to move or grip objects. In June 1970 the company began manufacturing and selling air cylinders. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed magnet-type rodless cylinders, hygienic design cylinders with a shape that is easy to clean, guided slim cylinders with added bore sizes, electric actuators with dust- and water-resistant specifications, the e-Actuator with an integrated controller, and others. It also handles products that hold and transport workpieces by suction, such as vacuum pads, vacuum gripper systems and multi-stage ejectors.
